title: Egyptian Lentil Curry
description: A flavorful and nutritious Indian-inspired lentil curry made with aromatic spices and a hint of nuttiness.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add curry powder and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add garam masala and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add lentils, coriander, salt, and 2 cups of water.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until lentils are tender.
Stir in peanuts and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with additional peanuts if desired.
